info.name: The Legendary Tribal Ring: Circle of Ancient Strength

descriptions.notStarted: Happy to have found the remnant of the Miwok Artifacts, Kopee says she has something to tell me. Let's go and see her.
descriptions.inProgress: Kopee offered to make me a Legendary Tribal Ring using the belongings of the Miwok ancestors! I should collect every artifact I find and take my findings to Kopee.
descriptions.completed: Kopee, using the ancestors' belongings, made me a ring. I received a Circle of Ancient Strength from her! She told me she'd make me one every time I bring her an artifact. I'd better take what I find to Kopee.
